intro: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in West Bengal have a recorded average package higher than their recorded total fee. This list of the best MBA / PGDM colleges in West Bengal where average package exceeds fees starts with IIT Kharagpur.
IIT Kharagpur is ranked 12 in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking, after 19 in 2024. It lists the flagship MBA at ₹13.04 lakh, matching the official 2026–28 GE grand total across four semesters.
Nine of the {{published}} colleges are in Kolkata, with one each in Kharagpur, Paschim Medinipur and Darjeeling. After IIT Kharagpur, recorded averages fall sharply.
listLead: These are the top MBA / PGDM colleges in West Bengal 2026 on this value filter. Some Kolkata cards show a supply-chain or PGP title rather than a flagship MBA, so compare official programme names first.
snapshot: For the {{feeN}} colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private and {{public}} are public. Recorded average packages range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}, from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.

CAT is the most common recorded test, with ATMA, JEMAT and MAT also appearing. The highest recorded package is {{highestMax}}, at Siliguri Institute of Technology, which is not that college's ₹5 lakh average in 2023.
firstCollegesLead: IIT Kharagpur's 2024 recorded average of ₹21 lakh sits close to our fee figure only if that fee is complete. The official VGSoM fee notice is the right source for the two-year MBA cost.
IISWBM, Kolkata, is listed with a PGP in Supply Chain Management at ₹75,000, not a flagship MBA. ISB&M Kolkata is listed with a PGDM in Supply Chain at ₹10.6 lakh and a 2022 average of ₹11 lakh.

sections.heading: Public institutes and Kolkata private colleges
paragraphs: Vidyasagar University is the other public institute, with a recorded MBA fee of ₹80,000 and a 2024 average of ₹4.5 lakh. Confirm the official full-programme fee.
Haldia Institute of Technology is listed under Kolkata in our records. Check the official campus location before you plan travel or housing.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in West Bengal have an average package above fees?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges in West Bengal on this filter. Both a recorded fee and a recorded average package are required.

faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur is ranked 12 in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, after 19 in 2024.

faqs.question: What is the recorded MBA fee for IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: Our card now lists the flagship MBA at ₹13.04 lakh, matching the official 2026–28 VGSoM GE grand total across four semesters.

faqs.question: Which exams do these West Bengal colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the most frequently recorded test, followed by ATMA, JEMAT and MAT. Confirm the latest process on the official admission page.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}. IIT Kharagpur's 2024 average of ₹21 lakh is one batch's record, not a promise.
